vBRIEFInfo.description: Auto-synthesized minimal plan for PAN-2254: unstick endpoint prescribes 'git reset --hard origin/main' when local main is merely ahead — destructive advice for a recoverable state

plan.title: unstick endpoint prescribes 'git reset --hard origin/main' when local main is merely ahead — destructive advice for a recoverable state
plan.author: overdeck/auto-start

narratives.Problem: POST /api/workspaces/:id/unstick refused with: 'Workspace git state is not yet repaired. Run: git reset --hard origin/main in the project repo'. The actual state was local main 10 commits AHEAD of origin (unpushed deacon state-sync commits) plus one dirty spec file — fully recoverable by committing and pushing. Following the endpoint's advice would have destroyed all 10 commits. The repair check should distinguish diverged/behind (may need repair) from ahead/dirty (push or commit), and must never prescribe reset --hard; suggest the recoverable action instead. Observed 2026-07-02 while unsticking PAN-2222's feedback_delivery_needs_you.
